cloudflareWorker.description: Secrets to be set via wrangler secret put (not GitHub)

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Admin bearer token for Worker endpoints
secrets.command: wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN --env staging  # never production (ADR-012 R2)

secrets.name: FORMS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: AES-GCM key for email signup encryption (min 32 chars)

secrets.name: X_OCR_INTERNAL
secrets.description: CI/CD internal auth secret for X-OCR-Internal header
secrets.command: wrangler secret put X_OCR_INTERNAL --env staging  # never production (ADR-012 R2)

secrets.name: SHARED_REPORT_SIGNING_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC signing key for SharedReport AND sponsor-home signed-link tokens (min 32 chars, distinct per env). FAIL-CLOSED: if unset, /sharedReport signed links and the ENTIRE /sponsor screen are inert (mint returns null). Shared across both token kinds (OSE-272 / PR #567). verify-secrets.js only checks GitHub-Actions env secrets, but the deploy-staging/deploy-production jobs now HARD-GATE on `wrangler secret list` before deploy (CCR-PR567 H2) — an unset secret fails the deploy. Still confirm with `wrangler secret list --env {env}` at sign-off.

secrets.name: RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PEPPER
secrets.description: HMAC key for rate-limit and beacon-dedup KV keys (min 32 chars, distinct per env, its own secret: not IP_HASH_PEPPER). Without it the keys fall back to bare SHA-256, which reverses to the visitor IP (OSE-1447); the Worker logs RATE_LIMIT_PEPPER_MISSING. The deploy-staging/deploy-production jobs HARD-GATE on `wrangler secret list` (name only; length is enforced by scripts/set-secrets.sh at provisioning). Rotation is free: buckets live 60 s, dedup keys 300 s.
secrets.command: openssl rand -hex 32 | wrangler secret put RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PEPPER --env {staging|production}

secrets.name: ANON_ID_HASH_PEPPER
secrets.description: Keys scan_node_returns.anonymous_id (lib/scan-node-key.ts) and hashes anon_id_returns (min 32 chars, distinct per env, its own secret: OSE-272 Q1). Without it scans are stored with no id and returning visitors are not counted; the raw cookie value is never stored (OSE-1659). The deploy-production job HARD-GATES on `wrangler secret list` (TL-078, 2026-10-10: without it the visitor count falls back to a stored browser-name hash); deploy-staging only WARNS until it is provisioned there. Rotating it resets return counts, by design (pepper_epoch, migration 0091).
secrets.command: openssl rand -hex 32 | wrangler secret put ANON_ID_HASH_PEPPER --env {staging|production}
